title: Level preset
description: data/presets/<id>.json (V8, A5; YOK-198): how one special looks at one level. A special names its preset per level (levels.1.preset, levels.2.preset, levels.3.evolution.preset); this file says which special and level it is for, and the validator checks the two agree. Presentation only: the sim never reads a preset. A special with no preset file at a level gets the default hit spark, coloured by the move's source (V5). Authored by asset-smith (AM5) once the VFX textures are approved.

special.description: The special (data/moves/<id>.json, kind special) this preset dresses.

colour.description: The move's colour at this level (V8). The hit spark uses it unless spark.colour is set.

spark.description: The hit spark this special makes at this level. Every field is optional; a field left out keeps the default spark's value.

colour.description: Spark tint; left out = the preset's colour.

scale_pct.description: Size against the default spark for the same hit (100 = unchanged).

frames.description: Ticks the spark shows (60 per second, F3); left out = the default (the hit's hitstop plus the fade).

textures.description: Spark images by outcome, paths relative to game/ (e.g. vfx/hit_sparks/foxfire-lv2-hit.png). An outcome left out uses the default spark image for it.

sheet_columns.description: Frames laid side by side in each image (a one-row flipbook played once over the spark's life); 1 = a still image.

tint.description: Multiply the image by the colour (default true: author images white or greyscale). false = show the image's own colours.
